GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which day comes right after Freitag? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Sonntag
   C. Dienstag
   D. Montag

2. Which day means "the middle of the week"? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Freitag
   D. Sonntag

3. What does "der Geburtstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. birthday
   B. party
   C. balloon
   D. candle

4. What does articulating a word mean? (1 mark)
   A. Whispering it
   B. Writing it neatly
   C. Saying each sound clearly
   D. Saying it as fast as possible

5. What does "die Orange" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. potato
   B. water
   C. lunch
   D. orange

6. How many fingers do we have on two hands? (1 mark)
   A. zehn
   B. zwölf
   C. acht
   D. sechs

7. How is "sch" pronounced in "Schule"? (1 mark)
   A. like ts
   B. like sh
   C. like k
   D. like s

8. How is "v" pronounced in "Vater"? (1 mark)
   A. like f
   B. like v
   C. like w
   D. like b

9. Which word has the sound "oy"? (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. Haus
   C. nein
   D. Tier

10. What does "Wir wohnen in einem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. We sell a house
   B. We cook in a house
   C. We play in a garden
   D. We live in a house

11. What does "der Kühlschrank" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fridge
   B. bed
   C. window
   D. living room

12. Which day comes right before Sonntag? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Freitag

13. How many German days of the week end in -tag? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 4
   D. 7

14. What does "morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yesterday
   B. tomorrow
   C. today
   D. now

15. What does "Wie viele Kerzen?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Who is coming?
   B. How many candles?
   C. Which cake?
   D. When is the party?

16. What is the plural of "das Lied"? (1 mark)
   A. die Liede
   B. die Lieden
   C. die Lieder
   D. die Lieds

17. Which German word is the number 3? (1 mark)
   A. zwölf
   B. drei
   C. fünf
   D. achtzehn

18. Which little word goes with the noun "Tee"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

19. What does "sehen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. to see
   B. to eat
   C. to hear
   D. to speak

20. What does "das Bein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hand
   B. leg
   C. arm
   D. eye

21. What does "warm" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cool
   B. dry
   C. warm
   D. wet

22. Which verb form completes "Vater ___ ein Buch"? (lesen) (1 mark)
   A. lese
   B. liest
   C. lest
   D. lesen

23. What is the plural of "der Bruder"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bruders
   B. die Bruderen
   C. die Bruder
   D. die Brüder

24. What is the plural of "die Mutter"? (1 mark)
   A. die Mutters
   B. die Mütter
   C. die Muttere
   D. die Mutteren

25. What does "klein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. strong
   B. funny
   C. small
   D. hard-working

26. Which German word or phrase means "sofa"? (1 mark)
   A. der Löffel
   B. der Topf
   C. das Sofa
   D. der Stuhl

27. Which German word or phrase means "kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. der Teller
   B. das Schlafzimmer
   C. das Messer
   D. die Küche

28. Which German word means "to see"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. sehen
   B. trinken
   C. schwimmen
   D. riechen

29. Which German word means "July"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. Juli
   B. April
   C. Mai
   D. Juni

30. Which German word or phrase means "song"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kuchen
   B. das Lied
   C. das Geschenk
   D. die Kerze

31. Which little word goes with the noun "Party"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

32. Which food group does "die Karotte" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Obst
   D. das Gemüse

33. Which little word goes with the noun "Nase"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

34. Which German word or phrase means "knee"? (1 mark)
   A. der Zahn
   B. das Ohr
   C. der Bauch
   D. das Knie

35. Which German word or phrase means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. das Ohr
   B. der Kopf
   C. die Schulter
   D. der Rücken

36. What does "kühl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. warm
   B. cloudy
   C. cool
   D. windy

37. Which German word means "cold"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. heiß
   B. neblig
   C. wolkig
   D. kalt

38. Which German word or phrase means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. der Schnee
   B. der Nebel
   C. der Wind
   D. die Sonne

39. Which completes "Der Ball ist ___ Garten"? (1 mark)
   A. auf der
   B. an die
   C. in der
   D. im

40. What does "in" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. in
   C. on
   D. behind

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the German for: sun, rain, wind, sky. Use der, die or das. (4 marks)

42. Write the German words with their articles for: sun, cloud, rain, snow. (4 marks)

43. Write three German sentences describing a member of your family. (3 marks)

44. Read: "Im Wohnzimmer ist ein Sofa. In der Küche ist ein Kühlschrank." Say where each item is in English. (3 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bathroom, potato, milk. (3 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: arm, sister. (2 marks)

47. Explain when we use dem and when we use der after a position word like auf or neben. (3 marks)

48. Read and translate: "Wo ist der Ball? Er ist im Garten." (2 marks)

49. Write the plural of Auge, Hand and Zahn in German. (3 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lunch, carrot. (2 marks)

51. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cake, candle, present. (3 marks)

52. Write your own Elfchen about a birthday. Check that it has 11 words. (4 marks)

53. Write the ordinal numbers for first, second and third in German. (3 marks)

54. Read: "Mein Vater heißt Juma. Er ist groß und nett." Write three facts from the text in English. (3 marks)

55. Write the German words with der or die for: father, mother, brother, sister. (4 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: eye, neck, friend, uncle. (4 marks)

57. Write the German words with der, die or das for: rice, breakfast, table, fridge, kitchen. (5 marks)

58. Write three words from a Kenyan greeting or from German that must begin with a capital letter, and say why. (3 marks)

59. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tea, tooth. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Samstag
   After Freitag comes Samstag.

2. B — Mittwoch
   Mittwoch comes from the middle of the week.

3. A — birthday
   der Geburtstag means birthday.

4. C — Saying each sound clearly
   Articulation is moving lips, tongue and teeth to say each sound clearly.

5. D — orange
   die Orange means orange.

6. A — zehn
   zehn is ten.

7. B — like sh
   German sch sounds like the English sh.

8. A — like f
   In most German words v sounds like f: FAH-ter.

9. A — heute
   The letters eu sound like oy, so heute is HOY-te.

10. D — We live in a house
   wohnen means to live and wir means we.

11. A — fridge
   der Kühlschrank means fridge.

12. A — Samstag
   Before Sonntag comes Samstag.

13. B — 6
   Montag, Dienstag, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag and Sonntag. Only Mittwoch does not.

14. B — tomorrow
   morgen means tomorrow.

15. B — How many candles?
   wie viele means how many.

16. C — die Lieder
   The plural of das Lied is die Lieder.

17. B — drei
   3 in German is drei.

18. A — der
   It is der Tee, so the little word is der.

19. A — to see
   We see with our eyes.

20. B — leg
   das Bein means leg.

21. C — warm
   warm means warm.

22. B — liest
   lesen changes to liest for er.

23. D — die Brüder
   The plural of der Bruder is die Brüder.

24. B — die Mütter
   The plural of die Mutter is die Mütter.

25. C — small
   klein means small.

26. C — das Sofa
   sofa in German is das Sofa.

27. D — die Küche
   kitchen in German is die Küche.

28. A — sehen
   to see in German is sehen.

29. A — Juli
   July in German is Juli.

30. B — das Lied
   song in German is das Lied.

31. B — die
   It is die Party, so the little word is die.

32. D — das Gemüse
   die Karotte belongs to das Gemüse.

33. A — die
   It is die Nase, so the little word is die.

34. D — das Knie
   knee in German is das Knie.

35. A — das Ohr
   ear in German is das Ohr.

36. C — cool
   kühl means cool.

37. D — kalt
   cold in German is kalt.

38. D — die Sonne
   sun in German is die Sonne.

39. D — im
   Garten is a der word: in dem = im.

40. B — in
   in means in.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, der Regen, der Wind, der Himmel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, die Wolke, der Regen, der Schnee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist jung. Sie ist lustig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence with capital letters and full stops.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: The sofa is in the living room. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct place and 1 mark for the items.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Arm, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: dem with der and das nouns (dem Tisch, dem Bett) and der with die nouns (der Tür).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dem with der nouns, 1 mark for dem with das nouns, 1 mark for der with die nouns.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Where is the ball? It is in the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Augen, die Hände, die Zähne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Mittagessen, die Karotte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kuchen, die Kerze, das Geschenk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Kuchen / Süße Kerzen / Wir singen zusammen / Ich bin heute zehn / Danke!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the 1-2-3-4-1 pattern, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for capital letters, 1 mark for meaning.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: der erste, der zweite, der dritte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: The father is called Juma. He is tall. He is kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Vater, die Mutter, der Bruder, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each noun with the correct article.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Auge, der Hals, der Freund, der Onkel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

57. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, das Frühstück, der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen, Amina, Kenia. Nouns, names and the first word of a sentence begin with capitals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for examples, 1 mark for nouns, 1 mark for names.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tee, der Zahn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
